# Summary

Write your notes here. R chunks calculate results and generate plots in the PDF.

For observations $x_1,\ldots,x_n$, the sample mean is

$$
\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i.
$$

# R calculations

```{r}
x <- c(2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9)
mean(x)
sd(x)
summary(x)
```

# A plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
plot(cars$speed, cars$dist,
     pch = 19, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "Speed (mph)", ylab = "Stopping distance (ft)",
     main = "Speed and stopping distance")
abline(lm(dist ~ speed, data = cars), col = "tomato", lwd = 2)
```
